answers.label: Feedback on refined scope 2 definition
answers.text: We support the refinement of the Scope 2 definition in principle, as it aligns with the official status of the CEA database as a tool for authentic baseline quantification. However, we urge the GHG Protocol to provide simplified "Safe Harbor" guidelines for MSMEs. Without such measures, the transition to a highly technical attributional framework will likely drive up consultancy costs and prevent small-scale industries from participating in transparent carbon reporting
